source.title: Dubai Media Office
source.quote: The value of real estate transactions exceeded AED634 billion with the number of transactions reaching over 166,400 real estate transactions in 2023.

source.title: Dubai Land Department
source.quote: Real estate transactions alone totalled 226,000, with a combined value of AED761 billion, a remarkable 36 percent growth in volume and 20 percent growth in value year-on-year.

source.title: DLD Annual Data Review 2025
source.quote: Dubai recorded 270,328 real estate transactions in 2025, up 20% from 2024, while total transaction value increased 20% to AED 917 billion.

investorsSource.title: Dubai Media Office
investorsSource.quote: The investor base continued to expand, reaching around 193.1 thousand, an increase of 24%, including 129.6 thousand new investors

source.title: Dubai Media Office
source.quote: total transactions reaching AED252 billion, marking a 31% year-on-year increase in value and a 6% rise in volume

source.title: Emirates 24|7 (DLD data; not an official release)
source.quote: January to September 2026 saw 165,018 transactions worth Dh574.12 billion

periodsNote: * 9M 2026 is a media tally of DLD data, not an official DLD release.
topAreasNote: Top 10 communities by investment value, 2025 (DLD Annual Data Review). DLD community names: Marsa Dubai is Dubai Marina, Hadaeq Sheikh MBR is Mohammed Bin Rashid Gardens.

topAreasSource.title: DLD Annual Data Review 2025 (PDF)
topAreasSource.quote: Business Bay led all communities by investment value in 2025, generating AED 40 billion. Marsa Dubai followed at AED 30 billion, while Madinat Al Mataar and DIP Second each recorded AED 25 billion. Al Barsha South Fourth contributed a further AED 24 billion

signals.text: Sales: 217,889 transactions worth AED 680bn in 2025, the largest category; mortgages AED 180bn, gifts AED 57bn.
Off-plan was 63.3% of investment activity in 2025 (61.0% in 2024): 138K off-plan vs 102K ready vs 30K land transactions.

source.title: DLD Annual Data Review 2025
source.quote: Off-plan activity accounted for 63.3% of total investment activity in 2025, compared with 61.0% in 2024

signals.text: Average sale prices 2025: villas AED 16,791/m² (+15%), units AED 20,666/m² (+6%).

source.title: DLD Annual Data Review 2025 (PDF)
source.quote: Average villa prices reached AED 16,791 per sq.m in 2025, increasing 15% from 2024. Average unit prices rose 6% to AED 20,666 per sq.m.

signals.text: Official residential price index +9.81% in 2025 (villas +14.83%, apartments +7.38%).

source.title: Gulf News (Dubai Real Estate Price Index)

signals.text: Residential freehold unit rents +13.5% to AED 1,141/m² a year; rental contracts passed 1 million (AED 98.9bn of annual rent).
Palm Jumeirah luxury units: 912 investments worth AED 9.8bn at AED 53,186/m², the highest-priced community in 2025.
Dubai Real Estate Sector Strategy 2033 target: AED 1 trillion in transaction value (+70%).

source.title: Dubai Media Office
source.quote: the Dubai Real Estate Sector Strategy 2033, which seeks to raise transaction volume by 70% to reach AED 1 trillion.

signals.text: Dubai 2040: population from 3.3m (2020) to 5.8m; hotel and tourism land +134%; public beaches +400%.

source.title: Dubai Media Office
source.quote: the number of Dubai residents is expected to increase from 3.3 million in 2020 to 5.8 million by 2040
